guard/30465.htm.text: Guard Herven: You are a new face. Have you come from foreign lands? You must know that Dion s local specialty is the mandragora! Well then, do you know where the largest Mandragora Farm in Dion is? If you just follow the road in front of me, you can take a look at Aaron Nightshade's Mandragora Farm…
